job.question: What are the evaluation criteria and their weights used in Level IV of the LACERS 2025 actuarial consulting services RFP?
job.expected_facts: Professionalism 15; Proposed Scope of Services Description and Methodology 30; Qualifications, Experience, and Accomplishments 35; Value of Cost 20; Total 100.
job.acceptance: Professionalism15, proposed scope/method30, qualifications/experience35, value/cost20. Points or percentages accepted because weights total100.

reviews.reason: This is a 2024 Illinois State Retirement Systems RFP, not the LACERS 2025 RFP. Its evaluation section lists criteria without weights and does not identify a Level IV evaluation.
quotes: State Retirement Systems Request for Proposal for Actuarial Consulting Services (System Reference # 24100) Issued on February 2, 2024
SRS will consider the following various elements in the decision process, ranked in no specific order

Proposals will be evaluated based on criteria, including: (1) the vendor’s responsiveness and responsibility; (2) the vendor’s background; (3) the vendor’s actuarial staff support; (4) the vendor’s technical ability & experience; (5) the vendor’s ability to meet deliverables; (6) the vendor’s prior performance; and (7) price.
